newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices stable on local support.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices stable on local support.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices remained mostly steady on the active presence of local and traditional overseas buyers at the weekly auction in Chittagong on Tuesday, brokers said.
They said Pakistan, Afghanistan, Poland and Russia were in the market which saw active support from local buyers, especially from blenders of good liquoring smaller brokens tea.

Some 0.8 million kg of teas were sold at the auction. The average price was 49.96 taka per kg, 0.05 taka down from previous level. The next auction will be held on January 14 with an expected offer of 935,000 kg.
